grammar_concept.title: Polite Requests with Can / Could
grammar_concept.rule: Use "Can I have...?" or the more formal "Could I have...?" to ask for something politely. Avoid "I want" in service situations — it sounds too direct in English.
grammar_concept.simple_explanation: Em inglês, pedir algo diretamente com "I want" soa rude num restaurante ou loja. "Can/Could I have...?" é a forma educada padrão.
grammar_concept.example: Can I have the menu, please? Could I have a glass of water?
grammar_concept.example_translation: Posso ter o menu, por favor? Podia trazer-me um copo de água?
grammar_concept.common_mistake_pt: Em português, "Eu quero um café" é perfeitamente educado no dia a dia, o que leva falantes de português a traduzir diretamente para "I want a coffee" — em inglês isto soa abrupto ou mal-educado num contexto de serviço; o correto é "Can I have a coffee, please?".
grammar_concept.correction: Trocar "I want..." por "Can I have...?" ou "Could I have...?" em qualquer situação de pedir algo a alguém (restaurante, loja, balcão).
grammar_concept.real_world_example: Num café: "Can I have a cappuccino and a croissant, please?"

vocabulary.definition_en: a list of food and drinks available in a restaurant
example_sentences: Can I have the menu, please?

vocabulary.definition_en: the piece of paper showing how much you must pay
related_forms: Can I have the bill, please?
example_sentences: Could I have the bill, please?

vocabulary.definition_en: to suggest that something is good
example_sentences: What do you recommend? The fish is very good today.

exercises.prompt: Choose the most polite way to ask for the menu.
correct_answer: Can I have the menu, please?
exercises.explanation: "Can I have...please?" é a forma educada padrão para pedir algo num restaurante.
exercises.common_mistake_pt: "I want the menu" é o erro mais comum — soa direto demais em inglês, mesmo sendo normal em português.

exercises.prompt: Complete: ___ I have a glass of water, please?
exercises.explanation: Ambos "Can" e "Could" funcionam aqui — "Could" é ligeiramente mais formal.

exercises.prompt: At the end of the meal, you ask for...
exercises.explanation: "The bill" é o documento que mostra quanto tem de pagar.

exercises.prompt: Listen: what does the customer ask for?
exercises.explanation: No áudio, o cliente diz: "Could I have the bill, please?"
exercises.transcript: Could I have the bill, please?

exercises.prompt: Read: "Waiter: What do you recommend? Me: The fish is very good today. Waiter: Great, can I have that, please?" What does the customer order?
exercises.explanation: O cliente pede o peixe depois de o empregado o recomendar.

exercises.prompt: Translate to English: "Podia trazer-me a conta, por favor?"
correct_answer: Could I have the bill, please?
exercises.explanation: "Could I have..." é a forma educada; nunca traduzir "trazer-me" como "bring me" sozinho sem "please" e sem a estrutura educada.
exercises.common_mistake_pt: Traduzir diretamente como "Bring me the bill" soa como uma ordem, não um pedido educado.

steps.content: Practise the polite intonation of "Could I...?" — a rising, soft tone at the end signals politeness in English, more than the words alone.

steps.prompt: Order a meal politely: ask for the menu, ask what the waiter recommends, and order something.
Write a short dialogue (4-5 lines) between a customer and a waiter, using at least two polite requests.
